ValidationRule.description: validasi untuk membatasi ga bisa next stage karena proposal blm completed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISPICKVAL( Stage__c ,'negotiation'), Proposal_Status__c != '',
NOT( OR(Proposal_Status__c = 'Completed' , Proposal_Status__c = 'Send Proposal' , Proposal_Status__c = 'Closed' )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Proposal belum selesai, kamu tidak bisa lanjut ke stage berikutnya
